paper_title: Morphosyntactic probing of multilingual BERT models
caption: Probing accuracy with reduced training data.
model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the accuracy of two multilingual BERT models, mBERT and XLM-R, as a function of the training data size. The x-axis, labeled "Train size", is plotted on a linear scale ranging from 0 to 2000, with tick marks at regular intervals of 250, and is measured in unspecified units. The y-axis, labeled "Accuracy", is also on a linear scale, ranging from 80 to 94. The plot displays two lines: the mBERT model is represented by a light blue line with 'x' markers and a dashed line style, while the XLM-R model is shown as a dark blue line with 'x' markers and a solid line style. The mBERT line begins at an accuracy of approximately 82.5 at a train size of 0, rises to about 89.5 at a train size of 1000, and stabilizes near 90.5 from a train size of 1250 to 2000. The XLM-R line starts at approximately 84.5 at a train size of 0, increases more steeply to about 91.5 at a train size of 1000, and then plateaus at approximately 91.8 from a train size of 1250 to 2000.
